content:
Ava: quick FYI — seeing a spike in leads stuck in HubSpot 'queued' state after enrichment. A handful have been there >2h :rotating_light:
Priya: ugh, yep saw a couple when I was triaging. do we know if enrichment webhook timed out or if RR assignment missed?
Diego: looking at the webhook logs now. 502s around 10:12–10:18 UTC, but some leads show no webhook attempt at all. might be list filter mismatch on the enrichment pass.
Ava: sample problem lead IDs: 12345, 12358, 12399 — all missing owner after enrichment. They should fall back to `marketing-inbound` per policy.
Sam: can we quick patch RR to immediately send to fallback after X minutes? right now timer is 45m. suggest 15m.
Priya: +1 for 15m. Sales queue SLA is 30m from creation to assigned owner, so 45m is too long.
Diego: agreed. propose: change RR timer to 900s (15m) and add a fast-path for leads with enrichment failures. Also add a notify to #sales when fallback triggers.
Ava: sounds good. can we do a safe canary? e.g., only apply to leads with `source: webinar|trial` to minimize blast radius.
Diego: yes. quick snippet of the HubSpot workflow condition I'll apply in draft mode:
```
IF (EnrichmentStatus == "failed" OR Owner IS NULL) AND Source IN ("webinar","trial")
THEN assign_owner = "marketing-inbound"; set_property("fallback_reason","enrichment_timeout");
```
Diego: I'll enable for 10% of webinar leads first and monitor assignment metrics.
LeadsBot: Export ready — queued_leads_1943210000.csv (25 rows) — https://hubspot.example/export/queued_leads_1943210000.csv
Priya: thanks bot. I'll scan for SFDC owner mapping issues while Diego toggles canary.
Sam: minor ask — can the notify include lead age and enrichment attempt count? makes triage faster.
Diego: yes will add `age_minutes` and `enrichment_attempts` to the Slack payload. sample payload: `{leadId:12345, age_minutes:132, enrichment_attempts:0}`
Ava: also flag any lead older than 60m as high-priority in the sales queue UI. CX asked for better visibility.
Priya: quick note — we've seen a pattern where HubSpot enrichment returns unexpected country codes and the SFDC mapping rejects owner assignment. adding a normalization step might reduce failures.
Diego: logging the normalization work item. for immediate fix, can fallback also try assigning to `regional-ops-owner` if owner map fails?
Ava: yes, fallback chain: marketing-inbound -> regional-ops-owner -> pooled-sales. document this in the handoff playbook.
Sam: I'll update the inbound SLA doc and add the 15m assignment threshold + fallback chain. Will ping once live. :thumbsup:
Diego: canary enabled for 10% of webinar/trial leads at 10:45 UTC. monitoring dashboard shows assignment rate and mean assignment latency.
LeadsBot: Alert — assignment latency spike detected: mean assignment latency increased from 8m to 18m in the last 10m. Sending digest to #marketing and #sales-ops.
Priya: I'm on it — checking SFDC connector logs; will post findings in 15m.
Ava: thanks team. next steps: (1) lower RR timer to 15m (canary 10%), (2) add notify payload with age/enrichment_attempts, (3) add fallback chain + playbook note, (4) schedule normalization work. I'll update the runbook once Priya confirms SFDC mapping root cause.
Sam: tagging follow-up action — @Diego please create a short changelog entry for the RR tweak so RevOps can announce to Sales.
Diego: will do. changelog PR created: https://gh.redwood/revops/rr-timer-1943210000
Ava: closing loop — thanks all. ping here when canary goes 100%.
Sam: noted, will coordinate the ramp and post final SLA update in #marketing-docs.
